source: Allen Mouse Brain Connectivity Atlas, ProjectionStructureUnionize (is_injection=false, hemisphere=both). Oh et al. (2014), Nature 508:207-214.
corpus: Allen products 5, 6, 35, 36, 42, 44, 45 — the anterograde wild-type and Cre-line survey of the normal adult mouse. The Alzheimer, aged-cohort, retina and reference cohorts are left out rather than pooled into one connectome. Both hub maps are built from this same set.
hemisphere: Ipsilateral and contralateral are relative to each experiment's own injection, which Allen places in the right hemisphere for 2272 of 2810 experiments here (81%).
note: Per target structure, the strongest projection density reaching it from each other structure, split by side. One value per source, not per experiment, so the map shows anatomy rather than how often Allen injected a region. Self-projection and same-lineage pairs are excluded.
